The shop

Custom work, drawn in the shop

Hammer & Nail Tattoo is a custom tattoo and piercing parlor in Carlisle, Pennsylvania. You’ll find the shop at 139 South Hanover Street.

The studio can draw designs for clients, and clients may pick their artist. Already have artwork of your own? The shop will use a client’s own artwork when applicable.

What the shop does

Tattoos & piercing

Custom tattoos

The shop’s main work: custom tattoos. Bring the idea — the studio can draw the design for you, and you pick the artist who does the work.

Piercing

Piercing, at the same shop — tattoos and piercing under one roof on South Hanover Street.

Drawn for you

No design yet? The studio draws custom artwork for clients — your idea, drawn by the shop.

Bring your own
